gloss: abstinence from alcohol; prohibition of alcohol

definitions.gloss: abstinence from alcohol; giving up drinking
definitions.explanation: The act of refraining from drinking alcohol, either temporarily or permanently, often for health reasons or personal discipline.
A law or regulation banning the sale or consumption of alcohol. Used historically to refer to alcohol prohibition movements or policies.

examples.japanese: {禁酒|きんしゅ}を{始|はじ}めた。
{健康|けんこう}のために{禁酒|きんしゅ}することにした。
examples.english: I decided to quit drinking for my health.

examples.japanese: {禁酒|きんしゅ}を{続|つづ}けるのは{思|おも}ったより{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: Continuing to abstain from alcohol is harder than I thought.

examples.japanese: アメリカでは{禁酒|きんしゅ}{法|ほう}の{時代|じだい}があった。
examples.english: In America, there was an era of Prohibition.

examples.japanese: イスラム{教|きょう}では{禁酒|きんしゅ}が{基本的|きほんてき}なルールとされている。
examples.english: In Islam, the prohibition of alcohol is considered a fundamental rule.

examples.japanese: {禁酒|きんしゅ}{運動|うんどう}は{二十世紀|にじっせいき}{初頭|しょとう}に{世界中|せかいじゅう}で{広|ひろ}まった。
examples.english: The temperance movement spread worldwide at the beginning of the twentieth century.

notes:
USAGE:
{禁酒|きんしゅ} is used as a noun and often paired with する to form the verb 'to abstain from alcohol.' The する form is common in everyday conversation about personal health choices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {禁酒|きんしゅ}する (abstain from alcohol)
- {禁酒|きんしゅ}を{始|はじ}める (start abstaining)
- {禁酒|きんしゅ}を{続|つづ}ける (continue abstaining)
- {禁酒|きんしゅ}{法|ほう} (prohibition law)
- {禁酒|きんしゅ}{運動|うんどう} (temperance movement)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{断酒|だんしゅ} also means giving up alcohol but implies a firmer, more permanent commitment, often in the context of overcoming alcoholism. {禁酒|きんしゅ} can be temporary or permanent. {禁煙|きんえん} is the counterpart for quitting smoking.
